title: Sense and Sensibility Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 80
rules: If Sense and Sensibility has a Tomatometer score of above 80 on Oct 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: With 39 reviews, mostly from UK critics, the film sits at 79% on Rotten Tomatoes, and it has stayed between 75% and 82% since its debut. A 7.0/10 average and a Metacritic score of 72 point to a final score right around 80. To resolve YES, the page needs to show at least 81%, so the incoming US reviews would have to be noticeably more positive than the UK ones. That could happen, but it is less likely than not.
blind.falsifier: The US release on Oct 16 brings a wave of mostly positive American reviews that lifts the displayed Tomatometer to 81% or higher by the morning of Oct 19.

final.reasoning: The market's 0.34 midpoint is almost exactly my independent estimate of 0.33, so the price doesn't give me a reason to change my view. The gap is too small to justify a bet either way.
